# Mohammad Ilhan — Portfolio

> Portfolio of Mohammad Ilhan, an ML Engineer and Full Stack Developer building RAG-based AI systems, intelligent chatbots, and production web applications for freelance clients.

Mohammad Ilhan is a B.Tech CSE student at JECRC University, Jaipur (graduating 2026). Selected for a Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) AI project where he built a dual-model RAG chatbot. Certified in Machine Learning from Columbia University. Available for freelance work in AI/ML, full stack web development, and prompt engineering.
